name: aeg-d-dwarfs
title: Local Group dwarf galaxies: published line-of-sight dispersions with population mass-to-light ratios and atomic gas (v2: uncertainty terms; D-096 to D-102)
description: Version 2 of the Local Group dwarf-galaxy dataset under data standard 2.5.1 (D-083, D-084). Every value is v1's, bit for bit, except two changes D-096 requires: Phoenix II takes the source's preferred certain-members dispersion (Fritz et al. 2019; D-098 rule 5) and Fornax the source's stated best-fit Sérsic radius (Wang et al. 2019; D-101). Systems whose own sources state that they are out of equilibrium or tidally disrupted are recorded, not plotted (D-025, D-097 to D-100). Adds the half-light radius, ellipticity and distance errors, confidence levels, binary-screening classes and the uncertainty-terms table read at source in step A. v1 stays published. See REPRODUCTION.md, REPRODUCTION_RESULT.md, reading/resolved.csv and docs/decisions.md.
x_licence_status: LVDB CC0. Original papers: values transcribed with citation, not redistributed. AAS machine-readable tables and VizieR exports linked, not redistributed. Atlas tables intended CC BY 4.0 under D-004, citing the sources.
